flowchart TD
  subgraph sgEntree["Entree"]
    e1["bin/authentication_milter"]
    e2["lib/Mail/Milter/Authentication/Config.pm"]
    e3["lib/Mail/Milter/Authentication/Protocol/Milter.pm"]
    e4["lib/Mail/Milter/Authentication/Protocol/SMTP.pm"]
  end
  subgraph sgHandlers["Verifications"]
    h1["lib/Mail/Milter/Authentication/Handler.pm"]
    h2["lib/Mail/Milter/Authentication/Handler/SPF.pm"]
    h3["lib/Mail/Milter/Authentication/Handler/DKIM.pm"]
    h4["lib/Mail/Milter/Authentication/Handler/DMARC.pm"]
  end
  subgraph sgMetric["Metriques"]
    m1["lib/Mail/Milter/Authentication/Metric.pm"]
    m2["lib/Mail/Milter/Authentication/Metric/Grafana.pm"]
  end
  e1 --> e2
  e1 --> e3
  e1 --> e4
  e3 --> h1
  e4 --> h1
  h1 --> h2
  h1 --> h3
  h1 --> h4
  h1 --> m1
  m1 --> m2
explication: Le démon lit sa config et reçoit les messages en mode milter ou SMTP. Un gestionnaire central lance les modules SPF, DKIM et DMARC, tandis que les métriques sont exposées pour Grafana.
source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The daemon reads its config and receives messages in milter or SMTP mode. A central handler runs the SPF, DKIM and DMARC modules, while the metrics are exposed for Grafana.
